summary: Separate Production, Staging and Development identity environments and make https://ekodi.kr/auth the canonical production authentication surface.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly approved the Production/Staging/Development OAuth separation model and instructed continued implementation under the EKODI authentication constitution.
migrationPlan: Register exact environment origins, inject environment-specific Google client IDs, isolate session and deployment credential namespaces, migrate all first-party login entrypoints to ekodi.kr/auth, then remove legacy Google JavaScript origins only after live traffic confirms no dependency.
securityModel: Google sign-in is an identity adapter. Environment credentials and sessions cannot cross boundaries. Gmail, Drive, YouTube and other capability OAuth clients and token vaults remain independent from login identity and from each other.
rollback: Keep the prior production client and legacy redirect surfaces available while reverting runtime identity-origin enforcement and environment-specific client injection. Never roll back by sharing staging or development credentials with production.
verificationPolicy: Identity registry validation, auth contract tests, staging smoke, guarded production promotion and live Google sign-in verification must pass before legacy OAuth origins are removed.
